title: Paraphrase-Robustness of Safety Probes: Testing Whether Semantic Equivalents of Dangerous Requests Evade Monitors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Paraphrasing is the simplest adversarial attack, so understanding robustness is valuable. However, the finding is somewhat expected (monitors degrade with paraphrase distance) and the impact chain is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generating paraphrases with a second LLM and measuring detection degradation is straightforward. Training a probe with paraphrase-augmented data is a standard data augmentation exercise. Well within beginner capabilities.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: a degradation curve of monitor detection rate vs. paraphrase distance, plus a test of augmented training. Single experiment with well-defined metrics. Fits in 30 hours.
